A synced LFO square on 16ths, softened by a short slew, controls a VCA's gain. A Multiplier named Depth sets how much the square closes the gate, so the sound is chopped rhythmically into a trance gate.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Depth input is added to the Multiplier's Y input: higher means deeper chopping. The LFO follows the transport tempo.

Tip: use it on a pad or drone and automate Depth for builds.

preset.description: The reverb's tail is pitched up an octave and fed back into it, so every echo climbs: a halo of ever higher voices above the sound. A limiter keeps the loop bounded. Shared inputs Mix, Shimmer (loop amount) and Freeze.

help.text:
A Reverb whose wet signal goes through a Pitch Shifter (up 12 semitones), a Shimmer VCA and a Loop Limiter compressor, then back into the reverb. Each echo is an octave higher than the last; the limiter keeps the loop from running away.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. Mix is added to the reverb mix, Shimmer to the loop gain (more means more climbing echoes), and a gate into Freeze holds the tail. The tail is long, about 20 seconds.

Tip: play single sustained notes and raise Shimmer slowly.

preset.description: The same loop, but a fifth up: each echo moves to the next fifth, so the halo is open and suspended rather than bright. A longer window keeps it smooth. Shared inputs Mix, Shimmer and Freeze.

help.text:
The same loop as Shimmer Verb: the reverb's wet signal passes through a Pitch Shifter, a gain stage and a limiter before returning. Here the shift is a fifth (7 semitones) with a longer window, so the repeats stack into open fifths.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. Mix is added to the reverb mix, Shimmer to the loop gain, and a gate into Freeze holds the tail. The tail is long, about 22 seconds.

Tip: with Shimmer low it adds a soft ghost fifth; with it high the tail becomes a wide suspended chord.

preset.description: A copy of the sound an octave down, with its top taken off, mixed under the original: a bass, a lead or a kick gets a floor. Shared input Sub (the amount of the lower octave).

help.text:
A Pitch Shifter drops a copy of the sound one octave, a 1-pole low-pass at 400 Hz rounds its top off, and a VCA named Sub sets its level. The result is mixed under the original, which passes through unchanged.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Sub input is added to the Sub gain: more adds more low octave. It works best on one note at a time, as a pitch shifter does not follow chords cleanly.

Tip: use it on a mono bass line or a lead, and keep Sub moderate to avoid clipping.

preset.description: Two copies, a few cents sharp and flat, each wandering a little, plus a light chorus: a single voice or lead becomes a small ensemble. Shared input Spread (the detune).

help.text:
Two Pitch Shifters, one 9 cents sharp and one 9 cents flat, each with a little drift, plus a light Chorus. The dry sound and both copies go into the chorus, which makes the result wider.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Spread input is added to both shifters' Fine knobs in opposite directions, widening the detune. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: works well on a single voice, a lead or a mono synth that needs width.

preset.description: A short, resonant flanger on a slow sweep: the whoosh of a jet passing over drums, noise or a full mix. Shared inputs Rate and Feedback.

help.text:
A Chorus module in Flanger mode: short delay (2.2 ms), deep modulation, strong feedback and a slow rate (0.12 Hz). The sweep gives a jet-like whoosh.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. Rate is added to the flanger's Rate knob and Feedback to its Feedback knob. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: put it on drums or a full mix; raise Feedback for a more metallic sound.

preset.description: Eight allpass stages sweeping slowly and wide, the right ear half a cycle behind the left: notches that travel through a pad, strings or an electric piano. Shared inputs Speed and Feedback.

help.text:
A Phaser with eight allpass stages, a slow rate (0.08 Hz), wide depth and spread at maximum, so the right ear is half a cycle behind the left. Notches travel through the sound.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. Speed is added to the Rate knob and Feedback to the Feedback knob. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: suits pads, strings and electric piano; raise Feedback for a more vocal sweep.

preset.description: Patch a kick or any rhythmic sound into Sidechain and the sound on In L/R is pushed down with every hit, then swells back: the pumping of dance music. Shared inputs Sidechain, Depth (lowers the threshold) and Release.

help.text:
A Compressor with a high ratio, a low threshold and a 3 ms attack, driven by a sidechain key. Whatever you patch into Sidechain pushes the sound on In L/R down, then it swells back over a 220 ms release.

Patch the sound to be ducked into In L/R, a kick or any rhythmic sound into Sidechain, and take Out L/R onwards. Depth is added to the threshold (more means deeper ducking) and Release to the release time.

Tip: patch a kick into Sidechain and a pad into In L/R for classic dance pumping.

preset.description: Five bits, a quarter of the sample rate, a drive and a band-limiting EQ: music through a failing radio or a 90s sampler. Shared input Damage.

help.text:
A Crunch module (5 bits, quarter sample rate, drive) followed by an EQ that cuts lows and highs and boosts the mids. Together this sounds like a small, failing radio.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Damage input is subtracted from Bits and added to Rate, so one control wrecks both. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: try it on a full mix, then bring Damage up for dropouts.

preset.description: Everything below 500 Hz and above 3 kHz removed, a bump in the middle and a touch of drive: a voice or a drum loop down the line. Shared input Drive.

help.text:
An EQ cuts everything below about 700 Hz and above 3 kHz and lifts the middle, followed by a Crunch module for a little drive. This narrow band is the sound of a voice or loop down the line.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Drive input is added to the Crunch Drive knob.

Tip: use it on a vocal or a drum loop and bring in Drive for distortion.

preset.description: The speed errors of a worn tape machine: a slow wow and a quick flutter wobble the pitch by a few cents, with a darker top, a little saturation and drift. Shared inputs Wow and Flutter (the depth of each).

help.text:
Three LFOs (a slow sine, a wandering random, a fast random) modulate the pitch of a Pitch Shifter by a few cents. A Multiplier sets their depth. An EQ rolls off the top and a Crunch stage adds saturation, like tape.

Patch a sound into In L/R and take Out L/R onwards. The Wow input is added to the depth of the slow motion and Flutter to the depth of the fast one. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: use it on pads or keys and keep the depths low for realism.

preset.description: Four tempo-locked LFOs from one Quad LFO, at a quarter, a half, one and two bars: sines and triangles that always meet on the downbeat. Shared input Hold.

help.text:
A Quad LFO in Divide mode with sync on. Four LFOs run at a quarter, a half, one and two bars (sine, triangle, sine, triangle), so all four meet on the downbeat.

There is no audio. Patch 1/4, 1/2, 1 Bar and 2 Bars into any knob or cutoff you want to move. A gate into Hold freezes the four outputs. It follows the transport.

Tip: put the slow outputs on filter cutoff and the fast ones on pan or amplitude.

preset.description: Four slow organic LFOs that wander like a living group, plus their sum: subtle analog drift for cutoffs, pans and detune. Shared input Speed.

help.text:
An Organic LFOs module: four slow, related LFOs that wander without repeating, plus their sum. Rate is 0.06 Hz.

There is no audio. Patch Drift 1 to 4 and Sum into any knobs, such as cutoff, pan or detune; they are control signals. The Speed input is added to the rate. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: give each oscillator its own Drift output for subtle analog-like detune.

preset.description: One random stream on quarter notes in three shapes: stepped sample-and-hold, a smooth walk and a springy wobble, plus burst triggers. Shared input Clock.

help.text:
A Wobble module clocked on quarter notes. Stepped is sample-and-hold, Smooth glides between values, Wobble adds springy overshoot, and Burst fires triggers.

There is no audio. Patch Stepped, Smooth or Wobble into any knob, and Burst into a trigger input. A trigger into Clock replaces the quarter-note clock; otherwise it follows the transport.

Tip: use Stepped on a filter for classic random pings and Smooth on pan.

preset.description: A Tidal slope looping every two bars with a slow rise and quick fall, in four phase-shifted copies for staggered swells. Shared inputs Restart and Skew.

help.text:
A Tidal module: a looping slope over two bars with a slow rise and quick fall. It has four outputs, each phase-shifted, and a trigger at the end of each cycle.

There is no audio. Patch Tide A to D into knobs for staggered swells and End into a trigger input. A gate into Restart restarts the slope; Skew is added to the Skew knob and moves the peak. It follows the transport.

Tip: use Tide A on a filter and Tide C on volume for movements that peak at different times.

preset.description: A two-bar breathing loop that never stops, and a six-second exponential swell each time Trigger fires: slow movement for pads and drones.

help.text:
Two Shape Envs. Breath is a looping Breathing shape over two bars; Bloom is a one-shot Exp swell lasting six seconds that starts when Trigger fires. Fade is the inverted Bloom, End a trigger when Bloom finishes.

There is no audio. Patch Breath for constant movement, and a trigger into Trigger to start Bloom. Breath follows the transport; Bloom is time-based.

Tip: Bloom on a filter cutoff and Fade on a reverb mix gives a swell that dries as it opens.

preset.description: Six-way randomness from Uncertainty: two slow fluctuating curves, eighth-note quantized steps in fifths and a bell-shaped value stored every half note. Shared input Clock.

help.text:
An Uncertainty module producing several kinds of randomness: two slowly fluctuating curves, eighth-note steps in fifths, and a bell-shaped value stored every half note, plus a trigger when it is stored.

There is no audio. Patch Fluct 1, Fluct 2, Steps or Stored into any knob, and Store Trig into a trigger input. A trigger into Clock replaces the 8th clock for the Steps output; otherwise it follows the transport.

Tip: Steps into the pitch of an oscillator gives a random pattern in fifths.

preset.description: Two leaky neurons that fire and inhibit each other: a steady gate, an irregular one, their XOR and A's charging ramp. Shared input Excite speeds them up.

help.text:
A Neuron module: two leaky neurons that charge and fire, each inhibiting the other. Gate A is regular, Gate B less so, XOR is high when only one fires, and Ramp is the charging level of A.

There is no audio. Patch the gates into envelope gate or trigger inputs and Ramp into any knob. The Excite input is added to both neurons and makes them fire faster. It does not follow the transport.

Tip: use Gate A on a kick and XOR on a hat for a rhythm that never quite repeats.

preset.description: A six-stage Segments envelope on the Gate input: a snap up, a dip, a slow bloom to a held sustain, then a two-stage fall. Shared input Stretch scales every time.

help.text:
A Segments envelope with six stages: a quick snap up, a dip, a slow bloom to a sustain, then a two-stage fall. A hold stage waits while the gate is high and the fall starts when it goes low.

There is no audio. Patch a gate into Gate, then Contour into any knob; Inverted is the mirror and End a trigger when finished. Stretch is added to the time scale and slows or speeds every stage.

Tip: use Contour on a filter and Inverted on a reverb send, so one gate moves two things.

preset.description: Sixteenth and eighth clocks through weighted coins that repeat every 16 tosses: two probabilistic gate streams and the accents where both land. Shared input Chance.

help.text:
Two LFO square clocks (16ths and 8ths) go through Coin Toss, which decides at each tick whether a gate is passed. The pattern repeats every 16 tosses. A Logic AND provides accents where both land.

There is no audio. Patch Sixteenths, Eighths or Accents into trigger or gate inputs, for example drum voices. The Chance input is added to both probabilities. The clocks follow the transport.

Tip: Sixteenths on a hat, Eighths on a clap and Accents on a kick.

preset.description: Macro movement locked to the bars: a smoothed rise over four bars, an up-and-down arc over the same four, and a pulse at the start of each phrase.

help.text:
Macro movement locked to the transport. Rise is a saw over four bars, slewed to be smooth. Arc is a Function that rises and falls over the same four bars. Phrase is a trigger at the start of each cycle.

There is no audio and no inputs. Patch Rise on a filter or a volume for a build, Arc on something that should peak mid-phrase, and Phrase into a trigger input. It follows the transport.

Tip: use Rise on a filter cutoff and Phrase to restart a sequencer or envelope.

preset.description: Random gates tossed between three pinged low pass gates, each tuned to a fresh D minor pentatonic note: a west-coast hand-drum garden that keeps shifting. Shared input Density.

help.text:
A Recall module makes random gates that a Coin Toss tosses between three pinged low pass gates. Each drum samples a fresh D minor pentatonic note from a Quantizer Suite, fed by Uncertainty curves. Drums are mixed in stereo with a send to a small reverb.

Press play: it makes sound on its own from Out L/R. The Density input raises the gate bias of Recall, so more means more hits. It follows the transport.

Tip: lower Density for a sparse pattern, and pitch the whole garden by editing the quantizer root.

preset.description: A Shift Register melody in A Dorian plucks a string Resonator while a sine bass echoes the same bits four steps later, through a dotted-eighth delay network. Shared input Lock (frozen ↔ mutating).

help.text:
A Shift Register (8 bits, A Dorian) plucks a two-voice string Resonator on its bit 1. Another bit triggers a sine bass through a low pass gate, so the bass echoes the melody later. A dotted-eighth Delay Network and a reverb finish it.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Lock input is added to the Lock knob: up freezes the pattern, down lets it mutate. It follows the transport.

Tip: freeze the pattern when you like it, then ride Lock for variation.

preset.description: Four soft voices of a D♭ major-seven chord, each swelling on its own free-running loop of 18 to 29 seconds so they never line up the same way twice, into a wobbling tape delay and a long hall.

help.text:
Four soft voices make a D flat major seven chord. Each is gated by its own free LFO loop of 18 to 29 seconds, so the swells never line up the same way twice. The sum goes through a dark filter, a wobbling tape delay and a long hall.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R, and has no inputs. The loops run freely and are not tied to the tempo.

Tip: use it as a bed under a slow lead or just as ambient background.

preset.description: Gusts of chance triggers strike two bell-like Modal Voices tuned to F major pentatonic, slow organic movement on where they are struck, in a wide reverb. Shared input Wind (more strikes).

help.text:
A Recall module makes sparse chance triggers that strike two Modal Voices. A Quantizer Suite tunes each to F major pentatonic, and organic LFOs vary where on the bar they are struck. A reverb makes the space.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Wind input is added to the trigger bias: more means more chimes. It follows the transport.

Tip: raise Wind in gusts and lower it for stillness.

preset.description: A generative techno loop: Drum Map kick, clap and hats with a touch of chaos, and a Polymeter Seq acid line in A minor through a resonant diode ladder whose cutoff drifts like weather. Shared input Cutoff.

help.text:
A Drum Map drives Punch kick, clap and hats with a touch of chaos, and a Polymeter Seq plays an A minor acid line through a Diode Ladder filter. A slow random LFO moves the cutoff like weather, and a dotted delay is on a send.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Cutoff input is added to the filter cutoff, which also follows the acid line envelope. It follows the transport.

Tip: raise Cutoff slowly for a build.

preset.description: A Harmony Master (bus D) walks a repeating loop of four D minor seventh chords, two bars each: a saw pad holds the chord tones, a plucked bass follows the chord's bass note, and a Pluck arpeggio traces the chord. Shared input Root (transposes everything).

help.text:
A Random module walks a four-step loop of chord degrees on a Harmony Master (D minor sevenths, Bus D). Three saw oscillators play the chord tones through a ladder filter, a plucked bass follows the chord's bass note, and a Pluck arpeggio is snapped to the chord via a Quantizer Suite.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Root input, a pitch, transposes the chords. It follows the transport.

Tip: patch a keyboard or sequencer pitch into Root to change key.

preset.description: A twelve-voice Swarm on a C minor ninth, breathing through a scale-tuned Filter Bank; eight related Organic LFOs slowly move its spread, cross-FM and the bank's scan and shift. Shared input Root (pitch).

help.text:
A twelve-voice Swarm plays a C minor ninth chord through a scale-tuned Filter Bank and a long reverb. Eight related Organic LFOs slowly move the spread, cross-FM, scan, shift and width, so the drone evolves.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R and is not tied to the tempo. The Root input, a pitch, moves the Swarm and the Filter Bank together.

Tip: change Root slowly with a glide for drone modulations.

preset.description: Four Modal Voice marimba bars on C minor-seventh chord tones, struck every 2, 3, 5 and 7 sixteenths; a slow random rotates which bar gets which prime, so the polyrhythm turns over every four bars.

help.text:
A Rotating Divider outputs triggers every 2, 3, 5 and 7 sixteenths. Each strikes a Modal Voice marimba bar tuned to a C minor seventh chord tone. A slow random rotates which bar gets which prime every four bars.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R and has no inputs. It follows the transport.

Tip: it works well as a background layer under pads and bass.

preset.description: Sparse Lydian plucks from a Macro Osc feed Grains, which scatters them back at wandering positions, an octave or a fifth away, with feedback and blur: a slowly shimmering cloud. Shared input Density.

help.text:
Random notes on 8ths, quantized to E Lydian, are played by a plucked Macro Osc at coin-toss moments. Grains records the plucks and scatters them at moving positions, an octave or a fifth away, with feedback and blur.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Density input is added to the Grains density: more means a thicker cloud. It follows the transport.

Tip: lower Density for sparse clouds with space between grains.

preset.description: Two Neurons firing at each other, nudged by slow organic drift, play metallic FM clicks, a modal knock, noise ticks and a rim; Bender glitches the mix and a scattered delay smears it. Shared input Excite (fires faster).

help.text:
Two Neurons fire at each other. Their spikes and logic outputs trigger an FM click, a modal knock, noise ticks and a clave. Organic LFOs nudge them, a Bender glitches the mix and a scattered Delay Network smears it.

Press play: it plays on its own from Out L/R. The Excite input is added to one neuron, making it fire faster. The neurons run freely; only the Bender slices follow the transport.

Tip: raise Excite for denser, busier rhythms.

preset.description: A blank Voice Cell: notes in, nothing inside yet. Open the board and patch your own voice between Voice In and Voice Out.

help.text:
A Voice Cell with nothing inside except a cable that keeps the voice alive while a key is held, so it is silent.

Open the cell, add your modules, and cable Voice In (pitch, gate, trigger, velocity) into them and into Voice Out. Patch Notes in and take Out L/R.

Tip: an Oscillator from the pitch jack, into a VCA opened by an ADSR, is the smallest voice.

preset.description: A blank effect: the audio passes straight through. Open the board and put your own modules between In and Out.

help.text:
A stereo effect cell with nothing inside: In L/R are cabled straight to Out L/R, so audio passes unchanged.

Patch audio into In L/R and take Out L/R. Open the cell and put your own modules between In and Out.

Tip: remove the straight pass-through cables once your own chain is cabled in.

preset.description: A pentatonic melody that plays with the transport, through Verb (medium room). Move Size, Decay and Mix while it plays; Mix at 100 % leaves only the tail.

help.text:
A Step Sequencer plays a C major pentatonic melody with the transport, through an Oscillator and the Verb module. It has no inputs; take Out L/R.

Press play in the host and the melody starts. Open the cell to change the Verb's Size, Decay and Mix.

Tip: set Mix to 100 % to hear only the tail.
